verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is fully open-source and self-hosted, and its core output is markdown/JSON (open, non-proprietary formats) with no forced API keys or paywalls, meaning there is no vendor silo to 'leave' in the first place. Structured extraction (CSS/XPath/LLM) further lets users get data out in standard formats.  Missing for 10: no explicit bulk 'export all my data' feature, no documented data-portability/migration tooling, and no independent hands-on confirmation of full data portability beyond architecture inference.
